awards.label: Best Overall
awards.why: A complete 3-way Matter dimmer kit with energy monitoring, and 1K+ bought last month.

awards.label: Best Budget
awards.why: $17.74 for a Matter dimmer with 4.6 stars, fade on and off, and away mode.

awards.label: Best Name Brand
awards.why: Leviton's Decora dimmer with bulb-type, min-dim, and max-bright settings and wired or wireless 3-way.

awards.label: Best No-Neutral
awards.why: The only Matter dimmer here that installs without a neutral wire.

products.verdict: The Matter dimmer to get for a light you control from two places. It tracks energy use too.
pros: Works with Alexa, Siri, Google, and Bixby through Matter
1K+ bought in the past month, sold by Amazon
cons: 4.3 stars, a bit below the single S505D

products.verdict: The cheapest well-reviewed Matter dimmer, with fade on and off.
Two S505D dimmers for about $15.50 each, and it's selling faster than the single.
cons: Review count is shared with the single pack

products.verdict: Kasa's Matter dimmer, with the most reviews of any Matter dimmer here.
pros: Local control over your network when the internet is down
cons: Costs more than the Tapo S505D

products.verdict: The most configurable Matter dimmer here, with bulb-type, min-dim, and max-bright settings to stop flicker.
pros: Bulb type, minimum dim, and maximum bright settings
500+ bought in the past month, sold by Amazon
cons: Matter has to be turned on with a firmware update in the My Leviton app
Costs more than Tapo or Kasa

products.verdict: The only Matter dimmer here that installs without a neutral, with brightness limits to tame LEDs.
pros: Works with or without a neutral wire
Matter over Thread, or Zigbee with an Aqara hub
cons: Needs a Thread border router for Matter

products.verdict: Eve's local-only Thread dimmer, with a touch-and-rocker design. Reviews are mixed.
pros: Matter over Thread with no cloud account
cons: Needs a neutral and a Thread border router

products.verdict: A cheap Cync dimmer that also joins Apple Home and SmartThings through Matter.
pros: Alexa and Google built in, Apple Home and SmartThings through Matter
cons: Needs a neutral and a ground wire

products.verdict: Enbrighten's new Matter dimmer with flying leads and a shallow body. Very new, with few reviews.
pros: Keeps dimming at the wall when the internet is down
Matter or the Enbrighten app, no hub
cons: Sold by a reseller with 1 left in stock at capture time

products.verdict: A specialist dimmer for 0-10V LED drivers and fluorescent ballasts, common in basements, shops, and offices. Not for ordinary bulbs.
pros: Controls 0-10V LED fixtures and electronic ballasts
Linear or logarithmic dimming, with min and max settings
cons: Only for 0-10V fixtures, not standard dimmable bulbs

avoid.verdict: The title says smart dimmer light switch, but the bullets describe a smart outlet. With the listing contradicting itself, you can't be sure what will arrive.
reasons: A bullet says it "Replaces existing outlet" and that "one outlet is Wi-Fi controlled while the other remains always on", which describes a receptacle, not a dimmer.
No LED load rating or 3-way information appears anywhere in the listing.
